name: (05) Animalism — 2 Intermediate — Ride the Wild Mind

system.description: Lock eyes with an animal and expend one or more Social Traits to possess it, directing its movements and perceiving what it perceives while your body lies still. The Traits spent determine what Disciplines you may also use through the animal: one Trait for simple possession, two to also use Auspex, three to also use Animalism and Presence, four to also use Dementation and Dominate, five to also use Chimerstry, Mortis and Thaumaturgy. You cannot augment the animal's physical abilities with Celerity, Fortitude or Potence, nor speak. If the animal dies, you return to your body and enter torpor. Wounds taken while riding are reflected on your own body; you may suffer Feral Negative Traits equal to the Social Traits spent, removable one-for-one with Willpower.
